messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Server specs
parts:
The resources available depend upon your subscription, and are covered in the documentation.
If your application is the one performing the compilation, keep in mind that storage is ephemeral.
If you are pre-compiling code to bundle in your application, the current environment is Ubuntu 14.04 and these are the packages installed by default.
